content.short: TesseractX is a multi-chain NFT marketplace and gaming platform.
content.description: TesseractX redefines NFT marketplaces by removing gatekeeping and high fees, enabling creators to connect directly with their fans and bypass intermediaries. It expands NFT creation with AI-assisted generation, bulk uploads, and multi-chain support, giving artists more flexible tools and faster launches. For buyers, the platform provides transparency by surfacing the best prices across multiple marketplaces and ensures secure royalty management, fostering trust across the community.
